post.caption: Kim Kardashian's earring fell in the ocean. In 2011, the Kardashians filmed a family trip to Bora Bora. Kim was tossed into the water and lost a diamond earring, and she cried over it on camera. Her sister Kylie put on goggles, dived in and found it, so Kim kept the pair. Fans turned the scene into a running joke, and in 2018 they were still asking on Twitter if she found it. In 2025, Kim said the earrings were among her first big purchases and were not even insured yet. The episode aired on August 28, 2011.
